items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

ctx.x: And this fellow, he used to go, he followed us from, let me see, while we was playing up the road in Long City. And this one used to play high and used to make him high notes there. Yeah. What were you talking about? That Long-Head. Long-Head fellow. Well he followed us way in Beaumont. Oh.
